description: This file defines a class 'ColumnLeft' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Common'. It extends a base Controller class and appears to generate the data structure for the left-hand column menu in the admin interface of OpenCart, a PHP-based e-commerce platform. The method 'index()' builds a nested menu array based on user permissions, which is then used to render the admin sidebar with various sections like Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, and others.
